svg.title: CampusConnect Admin — interface overview
svg.desc: A single contact sheet showing all eight CampusConnect administrator interfaces: dashboard, student registrations, students, post moderation, categories, content reports, profile, and settings.
svg.text: Eight connected views, brought together in one visual system.

g.text: Here's what's happening in your campus community.
A steady pulse across the last 7 days
Review and manage requests to join your campus community.
View student accounts and manage community access.
Review community posts before they appear on campus.
Join us for the Green Campus Week
Workshops, garden tours, and hands-on sustainability projects.
Meet people who care about our campus and make a lasting difference.
Found: blue notebook near the library
A blue spiral notebook was found on the second floor of the library.
Message the finder with a description to get it back.
Organize the topics students use to connect and share.
Review flagged content and help keep campus welcoming.
Manage the details associated with your administrator account.
Update your name and contact details.
Supporting a connected, welcoming campus community.
Choose how you receive updates from your campus community.
Control which administrator updates reach your inbox.
Get notified when a student requests access.
Receive a reminder when posts are ready for review.
Be alerted when community content is flagged.
A Monday digest of campus activity and engagement.
Changes are saved to your administrator account.
